purpose: Three simpler, more animated cartoon game art directions using the same ten models for comparison.

variants.title: A — EXPRESSIVE ADVENTURE
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a new Crownroad cartoon game model exploration board.
Input image role: REFERENCE ONLY for the ten subjects, faction colors and recognizable equipment. The user liked this direction but explicitly wants MUCH LESS DETAIL, more recognizable defining features, and a more animated cartoon game appearance. Redesign the shapes and finish substantially; do not inherit the reference's realistic anatomy, dense textures, decorative fittings, scratches, rubble, or photorealistic rendering.

Create one clean landscape board with exactly ten isolated complete models in five equal columns and two equal rows. Light neutral studio background, subtle grid dividers, one small plain modern header, small readable labels under each model. Full bodies and full props, generous padding, no overlap with neighboring cells or labels, no cropping. Consistent three-quarter game camera and light direction. Models should look like usable 3D game characters and props with animated personality, not a set of realistic statues.

Exactly these ten subjects in reading order:
01 SHIELD KNIGHT — ally: expressive bearded adult defender, one broad blue armor silhouette, teal tunic, big simple shield with ONE gold lantern emblem, short sword. His defining features are the shield, beard and teal tunic.
02 ARCHER — ally: expressive adult woman, a teal hood and simple cape, warm brown leather vest, clearly readable wood bow and ONE quiver. Defining features are the sweeping cape and bow.
03 MAGE — ally: older adult caster with silver hair, strong eyebrows, simple teal robes, large amber lantern staff, a compact warm flame in one hand. Defining features are the lantern staff and magical hand.
04 LANTERN GUARD — ally: enclosed broad helmet with a simple visor, dark armor with just a few large plates, teal cloth, readable polearm carrying ONE amber lantern. Defining features are the helmet and lantern polearm.
05 RISEN — enemy: expressive skeleton soldier with large readable skull, two or three blue-gray iron armor pieces, burgundy scarf, rough simple sword and small battered shield. Defining features are the skull and ragged scarf.
06 BLIGHT CASTER — enemy: thin skeleton mage with a burgundy hood and one flowing tattered robe silhouette, simple bone-topped staff with a green flame, casting gesture. Defining features are the hood, skull and green magic.
07 GRAVE BRUTE — enemy: broad barrel-shaped undead brute, massive shoulders, simple dark plate armor, burgundy sash, an enormous chunky square mace, one bold skull shoulder accent. Defining features are the massive body, shoulder skull and mace.
08 LANTERN WAR WAGON — environment: compact armored wooden wagon with teal curved canopy, four thick wheels, one simple roof ballista, two amber lanterns, one lantern emblem. Defining features are the canopy, big wheels and lanterns. No people or horses.
09 RUINED GATEHOUSE — environment: compact gray stone gatehouse, two short towers, arch with simple wood gate, one burgundy banner, very sparse moss. Defining features are the twin towers and arch.
10 ROADSIDE SHRINE — environment: little stone shrine with a glowing amber lantern, an exaggerated simple peaked stone roof and one tiny teal pennant, two large stones and two grass tufts. Defining features are the roof, lamp and pennant.

Material simplicity: large clean color regions, carefully shaped planes, smooth painted shading, a few broad bevel highlights, only a handful of intentional construction details. No fine cloth weave, no individual chain links, no micro scratches, no dense rivets, no ornamental scrollwork, no realistic wood grain, no dense cracks, no rubble carpets, no individual leaf noise. Every model should read clearly at small game size. Retain material differences through broad lighting and color, not texture density. Friendly stylized craft with clearly distinct ally and enemy silhouettes. No gore, no watermark, no photographic realism. More cartoon than the reference, still polished and suitable for a medieval fantasy game.

Style direction A: Expressive animated adventure game. Smooth sculpted 3D shapes, soft corners, lively readable adult facial features with expressive eyebrows and larger eyes, substantial hands and boots, roughly 4.5 to 5 heads tall. Clearly more cartoon than the reference but balanced and mature. Armor is a few chunky plates with thick beveled edges; cloth is large clean folds. Hair and beards are sculpted into a few flowing masses. Rich but controlled teal, golden amber, navy iron, burgundy and warm wood. Soft studio lighting, broad satin highlights, restrained ambient occlusion, no realistic surface noise. Each character has a lively action-ready pose: knight leaning into the shield with bent knees, archer twisting and preparing a shot, mage casting with a curved torso gesture, guard bracing his lantern polearm, skeleton taking an energetic stride, caster reaching dramatically, brute planted wide and swinging the mace low. Stagger the silhouette angles without changing the clear camera. Environment props use the same pleasing rounded geometry and color blocking. The image must feel like a polished frame from an animated fantasy game, with considerably fewer details than the reference. Header text exactly "A — EXPRESSIVE ADVENTURE".
